added: Place: a quiet coastal ferry cafeteria during a clear evening crossing, amber lamps, broad windows and distant harbor lights.
Activity: she pauses over a very small bowl of noodles after a long day, enjoying its aroma before the first bite, an unexpectedly gentle everyday moment for her fierce character.

Outfit: an original plum-colored fitted scarf-knit top with a deep draped square neckline, broad self-crossing shoulder bands and a shaped open side waist, paired with a cream wrap-front culotte skirt with a curved diagonal hem; chest and pelvis securely covered with opaque fabric. This precise cut is absent from our outfit catalog.

Pose and arms: seated at a window booth, torso gently three-quarters toward the camera, head slightly turned toward the warm bowl. Her own left upper arm descends naturally from her shoulder to the table, left forearm horizontal with left hand lightly steadying the bowl. Her own right upper arm runs down beside her torso, right elbow rests lightly on the table, right forearm rises gently and her right hand holds one pair of chopsticks above the bowl. Each hand has one job and each forearm connects visibly to its shoulder.

Composition: waist-up from eye level across the table, no foreground obstruction of her arms, her face and both hands readable; the window on her far side shows a dark calm sea, a tiny serpent-shaped pin only on her handbag beside her.
